Bail Bond Information for Harris County

After booking into Harris County jail, a judge typically sets bail at arraignment (often within 24–72 hours). Families often work with a licensed bail bondsman. A common commercial bond fee is about 10% of the bail amount (non-refundable). Example: $10,000 bail → roughly $1,000 premium, subject to local rules.

If the person cannot afford bail, they may request a reduction hearing or public defender.

For hearing schedules, contact the Harris County court.

Visitation Rules at Harris County Jail

Policies vary. Before visiting Harris County Jail, confirm:

  • Approved ID: Government-issued photo ID
  • Hours: Call Harris County Sheriff's Office for the current schedule
  • Dress code: Facilities restrict clothing that resembles uniforms
  • Video visits: Many jails offer remote options — ask when you call
  • Children: Minors usually need an accompanying adult

What to Expect After Arrest in Harris County

Typical steps after arrest in Harris County:

  1. Booking — fingerprints, photo, property inventory
  2. Medical screening — before general population housing
  3. Classification — housing based on charges and history
  4. Arraignment — first court appearance; bail often set here
  5. Transfer — serious cases may move to a state facility

Frequently Asked Questions — Harris County Inmate Lookup

How do I find out if someone is in Harris County jail?

Start with the official Harris County inmate roster. You can also call Harris County Sheriff's Office at (713) 755-6000. Online records often lag booking by a few hours.

What is the phone number for Harris County Jail?

Contact Harris County Sheriff's Office at (713) 755-6000. Facility address on file: 1200 Baker St, Houston, TX 77002.

How long does booking take in Harris County?

Booking commonly takes 2–8 hours depending on volume at Harris County Jail. Weekends and holidays can delay when a name appears in any published system. If urgent, call the facility directly rather than waiting on a website refresh.

Can I visit an inmate at Harris County jail?

Usually yes if the person is eligible and the facility is accepting visits. The main facility listed is Harris County Jail at 1200 Baker St, Houston, TX 77002. Bring government photo ID and confirm hours and dress code with Harris County Sheriff's Office before you go. Video visitation may be offered.

What if the person is not listed in the county system?

They may have been released, transferred, or booked under a different name spelling. Check Texas Department of Corrections and the Federal BOP locator for federal custody. Then call Harris County Sheriff's Office to confirm.

How do I send money to someone at Harris County Jail?

Ask Harris County Jail which commissary vendor they use (often JPay, Securus, or Access Corrections) when you call (713) 755-6000. Limits and fees vary by facility — confirm before sending money.
